inputs.model.prompt: 5-second stylish 3D cartoon using both reference images. Preserve the fuzzy yellow character from image 1 and the white-haired character, purple smiley sweater and drink cup from image 2. Place them in one playful blue-and-purple world. 0–1s: The white-haired character takes a sip; a tiny yellow blur streaks past behind him. 1–2s: Hard cut to a low angle as the fuzzy character lands, squashes flat for a beat, then springs high with an exaggerated stretch. 2–3s: Whip cut to the white-haired character’s face—his eyes widen, he leans back, then grins. 3–4s: The fuzzy character makes one fast curved leap toward his shoulder, with a brief hand-animated motion smear. 4–5s: It lands softly; the character raises his free hand and they strike a cheeky, perfectly timed freeze-frame pose. Snappy cuts, bold camera angles, expressive squash-and-stretch, polished character animation and fashionable purple-yellow-blue color blocking. Keep the cup steady and both designs consistent. No dialogue, extra characters, text or subtitles.
